author: jracer15
body:
I've finally finished the map and am proud to submit it to the map committee.  It's a walls map with a twist!  For so many of the maps the best way to play them is offensively by hunting down your next target or rush the middle, but in my map it's very defense friendly with hopefully there is teams that decide to defend their own castle by their enemies.  I also hope this map is able to create more teamwork, which has always been my favorite aspect of walls! Please leave your thoughts below!
[Update] I've edited the middle after requests, and I changed the basic template walls  surrounding the map to be more original, hopefully you enjoy this new version!

Download with YML!
https://www.dropbox.com/sh/0kgs3714756xaa4/AACoPe5GQr-WCWYNPVoci2sma

Pictures!
 http://imgur.com/a/WIm7c#0

P.S. Thanks for all who helped me for my first walls map!
